actions.text: Pull one day of `POST /pay/authorise` failures from the application log and classify them (validation, data, timeout, dependency)

Track card authorisations against the agreed 99.5 % success target as a Datadog SLO, so the burn rate pages before the target is missed

Cache the token in each client of `payment-gateway` until shortly before it expires — that removes at least 708,523 calls in the week to 22 Oct 2026 (the excess over one token per business call) and up to nearly all 1,086,928

bullets: **`POST /pay/authorise` fails 31,398 of 348,872 (9.00 %)** in the week to 22 Oct 2026 — about 4,485 a day. Each failure is a user or an operator who has to retry, or work that is not done.
**`POST /pay/refund` fails 13,290 of 29,533 (45.0 %)** — fewer calls, but the highest failure rate on the service: one in two calls fails.
The agreed target for card authorisations is 99.5 % success; in the week to 22 Oct 2026 it achieved 91.0 %.

1,086,928 calls to `POST /oauth/token` for 378,405 calls to `payment-gateway`'s other business operations in the week to 22 Oct 2026 is **2.87 per call**. Tokens are normally cached until they expire; requesting them per call multiplies the load on the token endpoint, and each token request takes up to 89 ms (p95) before the business call can start.
